final_answer:
Microsoft's gross margin improved from FY2023 to FY2024, both periods being reported on the same fiscal-year basis (year ended June 30) with comparable segment/accounting treatment, so no adjustment for non-comparability is needed.

- FY2024: Revenue $245,122M, Cost of revenue $74,114M → Gross profit = $171,008M → Gross margin = 171,008 / 245,122 ≈ 69.76% [DOC-1]
- FY2023: Revenue $211,915M, Cost of revenue $65,863M → Gross profit = $146,052M → Gross margin = 146,052 / 211,915 ≈ 68.92% [DOC-1]

Change in gross margin = 69.76% − 68.92% ≈ +0.84 percentage points, indicating an improvement in gross margin from FY2023 to FY2024.

ANSWER: Microsoft's gross margin improved by approximately 0.84 percentage points, from about 68.92% in FY2023 to about 69.76% in FY2024.
